messages:
Maya: Quick sync after yesterday's SLO bump — we agreed to turn the postmortem findings into concrete evals. Goal: ship regression promptset, extend perf scenarios, and run a micro chaos drill. Triage owners here.

Priya: I'll curate the promptset. Plan: include the 8 definite failures + 6 near-misses, 3 multi-turns, annotate why each failed. ETA 8 working days.

Dan: I'll add a nightly regression job and a fast pre-merge smoke check. Will wire results to Slack and attach failing examples. ETA 3 days for skeleton, 7 days for full.

Leo: I'll add perf cases for long sequences (512/1024) and stepped concurrency (1/8/32). Also add P99.95 tail monitor. Need infra changes; ETA 10 business days.

TestBot: Ticket created: RD-3499 "Postmortem 1988 -> evals + perf" linked to board "Platform: Incident Remediation".

Maya: Acceptance criteria suggestion: 
- Regression promptset: max 2% abs quality drop vs golden
- Perf: P95 latency increase <= +25% vs baseline for 0-1024 tokens
- Chaos drill doc + one recorded run
If thresholds violated, auto-create an escalation draft.

Priya: I'll store promptset at infra/evals/incident-1988/curated.json and include golden_outputs.gz + provenance (model hash, seed). I'll scrub any PII.

Dan: PR checklist I'll add to template: dataset path, test command, golden link, reproduce instructions, seeds, model-commit. Example: ./ci/regress --suite incident-1988 --baseline ref/2026-03-01

Leo: For the chaos drill: simulate transient GPU OOM fallback + small network latency bump; verify client fallbacks and no request loss. I'll run the first experiment next Thursday 04:00 UTC off-peak.

Maya: Good. Also add an automated notifier: when nightly regression shows >1.5% delta post a Slack thread and attach top 5 failing prompts; >2.5% open RD-3499 P1 draft.

Priya: Noted. I'll include grouping labels in the promptset (semantic category, multi-turn flag) to help triage.

Dan: Kicking off initial PR now with smoke job wired to CI. Assigning to @Priya @Leo.

Maya: I'll own weekly status until we get 3 clean full runs. Add any blockers here and I'll escalate. Thanks all. :thumbsup:

TestBot: CI run started: regression-smoke passed, full nightly queued.
